data.name: Fate's Retribution
data.description: When you are hit by a melee attack, as an immediate action, you can curse the creature that struck you. The target takes a -2 penalty on all attack and damage rolls for 1d4 rounds. A Will save (DC %1) negates this effect. You can use this ability %2 times per day. This bloodline power replaces touch of destiny.|Sorcerer_KarmicFatesRetribution_DC|Sorcerer_Destined_BloodlinePower1Times
